qaAssumptionCorrection.reason: The pinned original Strategy article places SourceQuote A1 immediately after an H3, not a paragraph. The first adapter required every entry to be in a paragraph; this was an inappropriate QA assumption for this preexisting source.
qaAssumptionCorrection.correction: Accept only a matching heading placement parsed from the pinned original MDX, while verifying the actual preceding heading, compact trigger dimensions, exact module/data, original full prefix, and real open/close.

findings: Source panels retain the original quotation, translation when present, editor explanation and complete source metadata; all 8 panels were actually opened and closed by mouse click or touch tap.

All four preserved native SVG diagrams were viewed in both viewports. Adapter structure distinguishes target contract from runtime actors; request and result arrows show one message. Strategy diagrams distinguish stable checkout steps, concrete pricing and a single selected member strategy.
All 10 final page cases measured documentWidth equal to innerWidth. Each source panel stayed within the viewport without shifting article blocks.
Agent Skills and Idempotency Figure images match baseline bytes and load correctly; captions and precise native video seeks/original chapters passed.
The archived distributed-transaction compilation retains its original introduction, links, chapter identities, noindex state and four replacement links, without invented SourceQuote/Figure modules.
limitations: This review uses dark themes and Chromium viewport/touch emulation; no new light-theme, physical-device, user comprehension or user approval claim.
Archived reading/link/state checks and image-based Figure checks are actual DOM assertions. This report does not claim a new full archived-article reading study or full-movie playback.
No external source GET or explicit full-MP4 GET was added; original-image navigation and the upstream full keyboard/no-JS interaction suite were not repeated.
